stories.headline: Nvidia beats Q3 estimates with $115.8B revenue, guides Q4 above consensus
stories.summary: Nvidia reported third-quarter revenue of $115.84 billion, more than $6 billion above analyst expectations of $109.1 billion, with adjusted EPS of $2.68 versus $2.48 expected. Fourth-quarter guidance of $130 billion also topped the $125.1 billion consensus, easing investor fears about slowing AI-chip demand after a leadership controversy had weighed on the stock.

stories.headline: Global stocks slip despite Nvidia beat as Anthropic IPO looms as next test for AI boom
stories.summary: World equity markets pulled back even after Nvidia's strong earnings report, with investors turning attention to Anthropic's upcoming IPO as the next major gauge of AI-sector valuations. The muted market reaction suggests confidence in Nvidia's business is recovering faster than broader confidence in richly valued AI stocks.

stories.headline: Dow drops 1.6%, VIX jumps 11% as hawkish Fed talk overshadows Nvidia beat
stories.summary: The Dow fell about 1.6% to roughly 50,759 and the S&P 500 lost about 1% while the Nasdaq slipped 0.7%, as Fed governor Christopher Waller's comments suggesting more rate hikes may be needed to contain inflation outweighed Nvidia's earnings beat. The VIX fear gauge jumped over 11% to around 25.5, with traders now positioning for hawkish signals in upcoming FOMC minutes.

stories.headline: Anthropic nears final IPO hurdle as tech stocks churn
stories.summary: AI company Anthropic is approaching the last steps before its initial public offering, timed against a backdrop of volatile tech-stock trading following Nvidia's earnings and broader AI valuation concerns. The listing is being watched as a key test of investor appetite for AI-related names after a turbulent stretch for the sector.

stories.headline: Gold falls 2% to over one-year low as hawkish Fed signals lift the dollar
stories.summary: Gold prices dropped about 2% to their lowest level in more than a year as hawkish commentary from Federal Reserve officials boosted the US dollar and reduced the appeal of non-yielding bullion. The move comes as markets reassess the path of Fed policy ahead of the FOMC minutes release.

stories.headline: Target earnings top estimates as inflation-weary shoppers chase deals
stories.summary: Target's latest quarterly results beat Wall Street estimates, with management citing strong demand from cost-conscious consumers seeking discounts amid persistent inflation. The results offer a read on retail resilience heading into the holiday shopping season.

stories.headline: Import prices rise more than expected while industrial production unexpectedly falls
stories.summary: October import prices rose 1.1%, well above the 0.7% forecast, while industrial production fell 0.4% against expectations for a 0.1% gain. The mixed data adds to uncertainty over the inflation and growth backdrop as traders await FOMC minutes for clues on the Fed's next moves.

stories.headline: CME FedWatch data signals markets bracing for possible Fed rate hikes, not cuts
stories.summary: Futures pricing via CME FedWatch implies traders are increasingly weighing the possibility of further quarter-point rate hikes over the coming FOMC meetings, a reversal from earlier cut expectations, after the Fed held rates at 3.75%-4.00% in October with some policymakers favoring a hike. The hawkish repricing has pressured both equities and gold this week.
